title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2024 Rule of Law Report
part_text: Aa. whereas Article 5(3) TEU states that ‘under the principle of subsidiarity, in areas which do not fall within its exclusive competence, the Union shall act only if and in so far as the objectives of the proposed action cannot be sufficiently achieved by the Member States’;
